title: CoDR：面向扩散语言模型的无训练置信度漂移重掩码方法
summary: 提出CoDR，一种无需训练、与采样器无关的细化方法，通过k次前向传播检测已提交token的置信度漂移，仅对模型不再认可的token进行重掩码与重生成，在多个骨干模型、任务和采样器上提升准确率且开销较小。
summary_en: CoDR introduces a training-free, sampler-agnostic refinement pass that detects confidence drift in committed tokens via k-partition probing, then remasks and regenerates only tokens the model no longer endorses, improving accuracy across backbones, tasks, and samplers with modest overhead.
